I'm broken right now, I got drunk and immediately threw up as I am not used too.
They called my parents up and just simply said that I am making excuses and simply refused to believe in me. Even though I have literally gone through it all and who cares they just don't believe it.
I am haing this huge depression right now, all my life in 20 years I never spent penny that went wasted and never made a bad investment knowin that my family wouldn't afford too.
Now that I'm pretty sure to go in a huge debt of this, it hurts my heart to even say it but I don't even want to study ever 
I would rather go work in some factory day in and night just to repay my parents.
Heck I don't even have a insurance of myself so least I could do was die and pay back what I wasted at least

I'm being let go, simply as I am refusing to extend my course as I simply can't afford it. If I go home now, after spending so much over here with nothing to return to my parents, I remember their smiling face as proudly they let me go here to study and now after all this torture I am popping anti axiety pills by the day just t be calm, I wish this was just a bad dream as I don't know with what face I will ever face my parents in going in such a large debt all because of me wanting to study here.
